description: The FD FORMAT clause (records written to the file are formatted to an external representation suitable for presentation or printing, and converted back on input), ISO/IEC 1989:2002 13.16.22 and 2023 13.18.24 - introduced 2002 (FORMAT is a 2002 reserved word per 8.9; at COBOL-85 it is a user-defined word). kb/Work PB5578.
source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. FMT9CL.
ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
FILE-CONTROL.
    SELECT F1 ASSIGN TO "fmt9cl.dat".
DATA DIVISION.
FILE SECTION.
FD F1 RECORD IS VARYING IN SIZE FROM 1 TO 20 CHARACTERS
    FORMAT CHARACTER DATA.
01 R1.
    05 R1-NUM PIC S9(4).
    05 R1-TXT PIC X(4).
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    STOP RUN.
